patterns: Games and toys crossover posts beat movie news on the big accounts: DiscussingFilm's GTA 6 NPC design note did 1,781,910 views, the MINECRAFT Throwing Disc first look 1,558,497, and the $129.99 baby Jason Voorhees doll 1,173,691.
Filmmaker quotes with one strong word travel: Danny Boyle on self-funding a third 28 YEARS LATER did 1,170,590, and Adam Driver calling the HUNT FOR BEN SOLO cancellation 'criminal' did 597,695.
Press-tour photo posts keep paying FilmUpdates: Hunter Schafer for BLADE RUNNER 2099 did 1,200,786 with 54,563 likes, and Mckenna Grace's new pictures 1,107,018.

One-line Oscar prompts with no context win for small accounts: CinemaTweets1's 'Winner of the Academy Award for Best Picture' was its best at 88,541; 'The Most Recent Winner of the Oscar for Best Picture' did 21,866, and its Spielberg top-4 list 16,203.

Old talk-show and interview moments carry ATRightMovies: Oliver Reed and Shelley Winters on Johnny Carson did 57,742, Burton and Keaton's 1989 Batman interview 27,765, and the open question 'Which actors have great chemistry?' 29,185 with 148 likes.

Anniversary re-releases and first-look posters lead RottenTomatoes: Denzel and Pattinson's THE TAKE poster 62,805, Prime Video's CRIMINAL first look 59,856, and Romeo + Juliet's 30th-anniversary return 57,104.
narrative_synthesis: A games-and-quotes Saturday: DiscussingFilm's GTA 6 NPC post led the board at 1,781,910 views, ahead of the MINECRAFT Throwing Disc look (1,558,497) and Hunter Schafer's BLADE RUNNER 2099 press look on FilmUpdates (1,200,786). Director and actor quotes (Boyle on 28 Years Later 1.17M, Driver on Ben Solo 598K) filled the top. A quieter weekend day: 69 originals scanned, 67 at 5K+, 61 at 10K+.
